entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R. Case No.24 of 2022, pending in the Court of the learned A.D.J.-cum-P.O. Special Court, POCSO Act, Rayagada, arising out of Ambadola P.S.
Case No.68 of 2022 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 4(2) of the POCSO Act, 2012, Section 9 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

entities.text: A.D.J.-cum-P.O. Special Court, POCSO Act, Rayagada
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, POCSO Court, Rayagada, by order dated 24.01.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, POCSO Court, Rayagada
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 10.06.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 13.07.2022, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.

7. Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

entities.text: Binod Yadav vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: To allay the legitimate apprehension of the learned Public Prosecutor regarding ensuring the presence of the Petitioner during trial since he does not belong to the State of Odisha, additionally, it is directed that petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the learned Court in seisin and shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
9. It is further directed that one of the family members of the Petitioner shall execute the P.R bond in addition to the sureties in terms of the order of the learned Court in seisin 10.
While releasing the petitioner on bail, learned Court in seisin is called upon to obtain instruction regarding antecedent of the petitioner from P.S.-Paragpur, Dist-Jaypur (Rajsthan).
If it comes to fore that the petitioner has criminal antecedent of any nature, this order shall stand recalled.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
